subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should allowed elevated sessions default to sandbox-confined exec unless elevation is explicit, or should current elevated-by-default session behavior remain the supported contract?
rationale: The choice changes the exec sandbox boundary and the documented meaning of `/elevated ask`, so automation should not pick the default without maintainer intent.

options.title: Default Off Elevated Contract
options.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, and host exec requires `/elevated on|ask|full` or an explicit elevated call path.

options.title: Keep Current Session-Wide Behavior
options.body: Preserve the current `on`/`ask` semantics and document that enabled elevated access makes allowed sessions host-exec by default.

options.title: Add Separate Opt-In Mode
options.body: Keep existing `on`/`ask` behavior but add a distinct sandbox-default mode for per-call elevation only.

recommendation.title: Default Off Elevated Contract
recommendation.body: Unset `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` resolves to `off`, and host exec requires `/elevated on|ask|full` or an explicit elevated call path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest history on the exec-tool split and elevated default gate, and the decision sits at that owner boundary.
